beaches.name: Artolithia
beaches.summary: Nude use is reported on the left part of Artolithia beach near Riza. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2006 to 2019; the 2012 report notes textile families sometimes present alongside naturists. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Agia Pelagia (Lefka)
beaches.summary: Nude use is reported at the northern side of Agia Pelagia (Lefka) beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2015, 2016 and 2019; the 2016 report found no clear naturist area but few visitors on a long beach. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Kanali (Preveza)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on the stretch between the Mango and Burano beach bars. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2012 to 2021 calling this stretch long-established and fully nudist; the central village beach stays swimwear. No official designation is documented.
